source: Items below are limited to what MASLOC's official site publicly verified at build time (homepage, publications page, gallery titles). No dates, figures or outcomes have been added beyond what is published.

items.title: Capital Behind Bars Initiative
items.excerpt: MASLOC launched the Capital Behind Bars Initiative in collaboration with the Ghana Prison Service and Aboboyaa Company Limited.
body: The Capital Behind Bars Initiative is featured publicly by MASLOC as part of its enterprise development work.
It was launched in collaboration with the Ghana Prison Service and Aboboyaa Company Limited.
MASLOC publishes the initiative on its official website as part of its mandate to widen access to microcredit, small loans and enterprise support for Ghanaians.
items.note: A launch date, beneficiary numbers and programme outcomes are not published on the official site and have therefore been omitted. Supply verified details before this article is published (see MISSING-CONTENT.md).

items.title: MASLOC Publications — Vol. I · No. 1
items.excerpt: The official news and reports publication of the Microfinance and Small Loans Centre — Vol. I, No. 1.
body: MASLOC publishes an official publication titled "MASLOC PUBLICATIONS — Official News & Reports of Microfinance and Small Loans Centre", currently listed as Vol. I · No. 1.
The publication carries the institution's official news and reports.
